config.grain_rationale: One record is a single legal entity (identified by ABN) plus its reported corporate income tax figures for one income year. The entity is the subject; the tax amounts are annual figures about it, not separate facts to map.

record_id.rationale: ABN is present for 99.1% and has 431 distinct values across 435 rows, so it is not unique per record; a content_hash over the row is the traceable key.

fields.rationale: ATO tax transparency rows name the entity as registered for tax purposes; all sampled values carry corporate legal suffixes (PTY LTD / PTY LIMITED / LIMITED), supporting a registered legal name rather than a trading/brand name. There is no separate trading-name column.
Column is literally ABN; profile shows 100% checksum-valid 11-digit values (abn_checksum_valid_rate 1.0) across 431 present values.

constants.rationale: Australian Taxation Office register covering Australian entities; country evident from metadata, not stated per row.

unmapped.reason: Financial amount with no ontology target.

config.notes: Only the 'Income tax details' sheet is onboarded; 'PRRT details' is a separate 21-row petroleum resource rent tax sheet needing its own mapping. No publisher documentation supplied, so entity_type is left unmapped rather than inferred from name suffixes; no status or licence-style columns exist. Financial columns deliberately unmapped (ontology has no monetary targets). Income year spans 2022-23..2024-25 in discovery, so rows are not all from the advertised 2024-25 report.
